Name: AoE Wand
Author: HappyFamilyFarm
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Tired of being swarmed by endless monsters in the mines? The [b]AoE Wand[/b] is a stress-relief weapon for the Adventurer's Guild that clears your entire screen with a single swing. Kill monsters, smash crates and barrels, cut down weeds, and vacuum up every drop — all in one satisfying blast. Built for Stardew Valley 1.6 + SMAPI 4.x. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI (4.0 or later).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install Content Patcher (2.0 or later).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and unzip it.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Copy both folders — [CP] AoE Wand and AoEWand — into your game's Mods folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game via SMAPI. Done![/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]One-swing screen clear: Swing the wand to instantly kill every monster in your full-screen view (fixed range, unaffected by your zoom setting).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Loot vacuum: All drops are auto-collected straight into your inventory. Your magnetism radius is boosted after each swing, so nothing gets left behind. Backpack full? Items drop at your feet.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Environment cleanup: Also smashes mine barrels, crates and boxes (with their usual loot), and cuts weeds (dropping fiber) inside the blast — while leaving stones, trees and machines untouched.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Full combat XP: Every kill grants normal battle experience, no exceptions.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pre-enchanted: Comes with Crusader, Bug Killer and Vampiric out of the box.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]No stamina cost: Swing as often as you like — it never drains energy.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Monster mechanics respected: Mummies need Crusader to be permanently killed (otherwise they turn to rags and revive); armored beetles are immune unless you have Bug Killer.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Where to buy: The Adventurer's Guild sells it for 1,000g, available as soon as you can enter the guild.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 (PC)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher 2.0.0 or newer[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8](Optional) Many Enchantments — without it, only the Vampiric enchantment is shown on the wand; all three enchantments (Crusader, Bug Killer, Vampiric) display properly with it installed. The mod works fine without it.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Eric Barone for Stardew Valley, the game we all love.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Pathoschild for SMAPI and Content Patcher, which make modding this game a joy.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to my Pappa and Mama for their encouragement since I am a 10-year-old boy.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for endless inspiration, tutorials, and pixel art reference.[/color][/*]
[/list]
